name: remote_desktop_access

storage.rationale: Provider state is owned by the host desktop services; this safeguard only enables an already-declared provider.

description: Declare and verify the host remote-desktop experience without overriding distribution display policy

experience.description: The experience a remote desktop connection should present.

provider.description: The provider adapter to inspect, or auto to select the best detected provider.

allow_enable_system.description: Permit enabling the system-mode GNOME Remote Desktop unit.

allow_switch_provider.description: Permit switching to the user-shared GNOME Remote Desktop provider.

allow_enable_user_unit.description: Permit enabling the user-mode GNOME Remote Desktop unit.

allow_disable_system_unit.description: Permit disabling the system-mode GNOME Remote Desktop unit during a provider switch.

allow_provision_credentials.description: Permit provisioning provider credentials; credential values are never stored in operator state.

allow_enable_native_provider.description: Permit enabling a native Windows or macOS remote-desktop provider.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

linux.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.

windows.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.
